outcome: NGAL expression in kidney biopsy specimens
KIM-1 expression in kidney biopsy specimens
cohort: Pregnant women categorized into three groups: normal pregnancy (n=100), preeclampsia (n=83), and pregnancy complicated with chronic hypertension (n=20), along with kidney biopsy specimens from 5 preeclampsia patients.
finding: Preeclampsia is associated with increased maternal plasma and urine levels of NGAL and KIM-1, and enhanced expression of these markers in proximal tubule epithelial cells, providing evidence of tubular injury that may not resolve within 2-3 months postpartum.
